name: Lunar Lemon 1g Live Resin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Lemon Peel x Moonbow #112 

Breeder: Archive Seed Bank 

Terpenes: Limonene, Caryophyllene, Linalool 

Effects: Creative, energizing, focused 

Aroma: Citrus, Pepper, Sweet 

Experience the celestial delight of Lunar Lemon, a multiple award-winning, sativa dominant hybrid crafted by Archive Seed Bank. This unique strain is the harmonious result of blending zesty Lemon Peel with the euphoric Moonbow #112, creating an intense citrus aroma that gracefully matures into a sweet, floral finish. Ideal for indulging in the early hours of the day, Lunar Lemon promises a truly delightful cannabis experience.
